name: Red Lentil Dal with Sweet Potato & Spinach
subtitle: Instant Pot masoor dal finished with a sizzling cumin-garlic tadka, with cumin yogurt and rice
equipment: Instant Pot, small skillet, rice cooker

macros.portion: About 2 cups dal over ½ cup rice, with ½ cup cumin yogurt.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Skipping the rice takes off about 100 kcal.

before: Start **~55 min** before dinner. The Instant Pot needs about 25 min to come to pressure, cook and release.
notes: The tadka at the end is what makes dal taste like a restaurant's: whole spices and garlic fried in ghee and poured over at the last second, while they're still sizzling. Mustard seeds should pop before the cumin goes in. Pour the tomatoes on top and don't stir them in before pressure cooking: tomatoes on the bottom scorch and set off the burn warning. Dal thickens as it sits, so loosen leftovers with a splash of water when reheating.

items: ⅔ cup basmati or jasmine rice
2 dried red chiles or ½ tsp red pepper flakes
½ tsp Kashmiri chili powder or paprika

steps.title: Rice on
steps.body: Rinse **⅔ cup rice** and start it in the rice cooker.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Dice **1 onion**. Mince **4 cloves garlic** and grate **1 Tbsp ginger** into one small bowl. Peel **2 sweet potatoes** and cut into 1-inch cubes. Rinse **1 lb red lentils** in a strainer until the water runs mostly clear. Thinly slice **2 more cloves garlic** for the tadka and set aside.

steps.title: Bloom and soften
steps.body: Instant Pot on Sauté (high). Add **1 Tbsp oil** and **1 tsp cumin seeds**; stir 30 seconds until a shade darker. Add the onion and cook 4–5 min until soft and starting to brown. Add the garlic and ginger, 1 min, then **1 tsp turmeric + 1 tsp coriander**, 30 seconds.

steps.title: Fill, but don't stir in the tomatoes
steps.body: Pour in **5½ cups water** and scrape the bottom completely clean. Add the lentils, sweet potatoes and **1¼ tsp salt** and stir. Pour **1 can diced tomatoes** over the top and leave them there.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.body: Cancel Sauté. Lid on, valve sealed. High pressure **6 min**, then natural release **10 min**, then vent.

steps.title: Yogurt and tadka setup
steps.body: During the pressure time: stir **2 cups Greek yogurt + ½ tsp ground cumin + ¼ tsp salt**. Set the small skillet on the stove with **1½ Tbsp ghee**, and put **½ tsp mustard seeds + 1 tsp cumin seeds**, the sliced garlic, **2 dried chiles** and **½ tsp Kashmiri chili powder** beside it.

steps.title: Finish the dal
steps.body: Open the pot and whisk until the lentils break down and the dal is creamy. Stir in **5 oz spinach**, **2 Tbsp lemon juice** and **½ tsp garam masala** until the spinach wilts. Taste for salt. If it's thicker than a heavy soup, add hot water.

steps.title: Tadka
steps.body: Small skillet over medium-high. When the ghee shimmers, add the mustard seeds and wait for them to pop (about 30 seconds), then the cumin seeds for 15 seconds. Add the garlic and cook until golden at the edges, 30–45 seconds. Add the chiles, take it off the heat, stir in the chili powder, and pour everything over the dal right away.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Dal over rice, cumin yogurt on top or alongside.

after: Pack 2 lunches: dal and rice together, yogurt separate.

source.label: Standard masoor dal tadka method, adapted for the Instant Pot
